mapper.sql: select tb.id, tb.parent_id, tb.parent_user_id, tb.tutor_id, tb.tutor_user_id, tb.status, tb.service_times_snapshot, tb.remark, tb.create_by, tb.create_time, tb.update_by, tb.update_time, p.name as parent_name, p.subject as parent_subject, p.grade as parent_grade, p.region as parent_region, ui.user_name as tutor_name, t.school as tutor_school, t.current_grade as tutor_current_grade from tutoring_binding tb left join parents p on p.id = tb.parent_id left join tutors t on t.id = tb.tutor_id left join user_info ui on ui.id = tb.tutor_user_id
mapper.select: where tb.parent_user_id = #{parentUserId} and tb.status != 2 and p.id is not null and p.status = 0 order by tb.create_time desc, tb.id desc
mapper.update: update tutoring_binding set status = 2, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where parent_id = #{parentId} and status != 2 and id != #{excludeId}
